verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for an agent framework with managed deployment options, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never documents an ADK capability for choosing a storage region or data residency. The ability to deploy containers anywhere or run offline is a self-hosting arrangement, and region selection on Cloud Run or Agent Runtime would be a host-platform feature, so neither counts as ADK's own residency control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
